sources.title: Provincial Health Services Authority employee remuneration and expenses 2015/16
notes: Alphabetical list of employees who received remuneration exceeding$75000 for the year ended March31 and their expenses paid during the period. Expenses may be reimbursed directly to employees and/or paid to a third party supplier.
The literal remuneration column is retained. No annual salary rate or missing compensation component is inferred; nothing is annualized.
No job titles are published: all positions are null. The reporting entity remains the printed Provincial Health Services Authority; no unit assignment or cross-year identity is inferred.
Two independent OCR engines read every original salary page. Actual PDF-painted RGB 300-dpi source bytes and all original row boundaries have independent complete-source checks.

Original reader streams/confidences/flags and all frozen review packets remain immutable. Every true disagreement, missing/unparsed field and source-name artifact is image resolved. A separately calibrated policy corroborates eligible unreserved confidence-only fields by exact independent agreement and source guards; these are not labelled personal image transcription.

Ninety deterministic source-only holdout rows (222 fields across all nine layouts) independently matched the final source readings. Four reviewer-only first-pass name errors are preserved transparently in additive reread evidence; no machine data was changed by the holdout.
Expense dashes require source-specific actual-image geometry or literal image review; blank regions or absent OCR detections never imply a dash or zero.
Original physical pages, repeated names/observations and source order are preserved. No deduplication or generic name casing is performed.
Compiled observations remain retained until root independently proves and adopts exact replacement scope.

This source cover defines remuneration as Amounts physically received by or paid on behalf of an employee for the fiscal year; includes but not limited to salaries and wages,taxable benefits,bonuses,stipends,MOCAP and sessional fees.
sources.publicWarning: Fiscal-year remuneration above the disclosure threshold is not an annual salary rate or a workforce census. Expenses may include third-party supplier payments; original expense dashes remain unknown (null). The published standalone schedule is unsigned and does not establish board approval. 85 source-name readings have an explicit contextual capital-I/lowercase-l qualification. Their exact affected rows, primary readings, visible alternatives and independently reviewed/root-adopted context are retained in provenance; glyph case is not claimed to be proved by pixels. Zulfiqar,Muhammad* retains the printed $481,982 current-period payment. The source footnote reports $333,272 salary, $19,724 MOCAP/retroactive pay and a $128,986 correction of 2014/15 unpaid-leave coding reported in 2015/16; no amount was subtracted, annualized or moved to another year. Literal row sums are remuneration $482,734,247 and known expenses $10,397,074, differing from printed controls $482,734,216/$10,397,046 by +31/+28. No source cell was adjusted to balance; the cause is not established.

sources.title: Provincial Health Services Authority employee remuneration and expenses 2016/17
notes: Alphabetical list of employees who received remuneration exceeding$75000 for the year ended March31 and their expenses paid during the period. Expenses may be reimbursed directly to employees and/or paid to a third party supplier.
The literal remuneration column is retained. No annual salary rate or missing compensation component is inferred; nothing is annualized.
No job titles are published: all positions are null. The reporting entity remains the printed Provincial Health Services Authority; no unit assignment or cross-year identity is inferred.
Two independent OCR engines read every original salary page. Actual PDF-painted RGB 300-dpi source bytes and all original row boundaries have independent complete-source checks.

Original reader streams/confidences/flags and all frozen review packets remain immutable. Every true disagreement, missing/unparsed field and source-name artifact is image resolved. A separately calibrated policy corroborates eligible unreserved confidence-only fields by exact independent agreement and source guards; these are not labelled personal image transcription.

Ninety deterministic source-only holdout rows (222 fields across all nine layouts) independently matched the final source readings. Four reviewer-only first-pass name errors are preserved transparently in additive reread evidence; no machine data was changed by the holdout.
Expense dashes require source-specific actual-image geometry or literal image review; blank regions or absent OCR detections never imply a dash or zero.
Original physical pages, repeated names/observations and source order are preserved. No deduplication or generic name casing is performed.
Compiled observations remain retained until root independently proves and adopts exact replacement scope.

This source cover defines remuneration as Amounts physically received by or paid on behalf of an employee for the fiscal year; includes but not limited to salaries and wages,taxable benefits,bonuses,stipends,MOCAP and sessional fees.
sources.publicWarning: Fiscal-year remuneration above the disclosure threshold is not an annual salary rate or a workforce census. Expenses may include third-party supplier payments; original expense dashes remain unknown (null). The published standalone schedule is unsigned and does not establish board approval. Their exact affected rows, primary readings, finite visible alternatives and independently reviewed/root-adopted context are retained in provenance; a unique glyph interpretation is not claimed. Literal row sums are remuneration $561,207,243 and known expenses $10,803,695, differing from printed controls $561,207,243/$10,803,700 by +0/-5. No source cell was adjusted to balance; the cause is not established.

sources.title: Provincial Health Services Authority employee remuneration and expenses 2021/22
notes: Alphabetical list of employees who received remuneration exceeding$75000 for the year ended March31 and their expenses paid during the period. Expenses may be reimbursed directly to employees and/or paid to a third party supplier.
The literal remuneration column is retained. No annual salary rate or missing compensation component is inferred; nothing is annualized.
No job titles are published: all positions are null. The reporting entity remains the printed Provincial Health Services Authority; no unit assignment or cross-year identity is inferred.
Two independent OCR engines read every original salary page. Actual PDF-painted RGB 300-dpi source bytes and all original row boundaries have independent complete-source checks.

Original reader streams/confidences/flags and all frozen review packets remain immutable. Every true disagreement, missing/unparsed field and source-name artifact is image resolved. A separately calibrated policy corroborates eligible unreserved confidence-only fields by exact independent agreement and source guards; these are not labelled personal image transcription.

Ninety deterministic source-only holdout rows (222 fields across all nine layouts) independently matched the final source readings. Four reviewer-only first-pass name errors are preserved transparently in additive reread evidence; no machine data was changed by the holdout.
Expense dashes require source-specific actual-image geometry or literal image review; blank regions or absent OCR detections never imply a dash or zero.
Original physical pages, repeated names/observations and source order are preserved. No deduplication or generic name casing is performed.
Compiled observations remain retained until root independently proves and adopts exact replacement scope.

notes: Alphabetical list of employees who received remuneration exceeding$75000 for the year ended March31 and their expenses paid during the period. Expenses may be reimbursed directly to employees and/or paid to a third party supplier.
The literal remuneration column is retained. No annual salary rate or missing compensation component is inferred; nothing is annualized.
No job titles are published: all positions are null. The reporting entity remains the printed Provincial Health Services Authority; no unit assignment or cross-year identity is inferred.
Two independent OCR engines read every original salary page. Actual PDF-painted RGB 300-dpi source bytes and all original row boundaries have independent complete-source checks.

Original reader streams/confidences/flags and all frozen review packets remain immutable. Every true disagreement, missing/unparsed field and source-name artifact is image resolved. A separately calibrated policy corroborates eligible unreserved confidence-only fields by exact independent agreement and source guards; these are not labelled personal image transcription.

Ninety deterministic source-only holdout rows (222 fields across all nine layouts) independently matched the final source readings. Four reviewer-only first-pass name errors are preserved transparently in additive reread evidence; no machine data was changed by the holdout.
Expense dashes require source-specific actual-image geometry or literal image review; blank regions or absent OCR detections never imply a dash or zero.
Original physical pages, repeated names/observations and source order are preserved. No deduplication or generic name casing is performed.
